# Dr. Mudita Jain Talesra - Medical Practice & Women's Health

> Dr. Mudita Jain Talesra (MBBS, MS Obstetrics & Gynaecology, FMAS, FICOG, FMFI) is an experienced gynecologist, obstetrician, and advanced laparoscopic surgeon practicing at Mudita Women Health Care Center in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. She has over 17 years of clinical experience, serves as former Professor & HOD of Obstetrics & Gynecology at RKDF Medical College Bhopal, and is an accredited National Master Trainer.

## Clinical Specializations & Services
- [Laparoscopic Gynecology Procedures](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/laparoscopic-gynecology-procedures/): Advanced minimally invasive keyhole surgery for uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, severe endometriosis, and total laparoscopic hysterectomy with 24–48 hr hospital discharge.
- [Obstetrics & Pregnancy Care](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/obstetrics-services/): Complete antenatal supervision, high-risk pregnancy management (preeclampsia, gestational diabetes), and painless labor support.
- [Infertility & Reproductive Care](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/fertility-services/): Evidence-based female infertility evaluation, ovarian reserve assessment (AMH), follicular tracking, and Intrauterine Insemination (IUI).
- [Cosmetic & Reconstructive Gynecology](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/cosmetic-gynecology/): Certified specialized vaginoplasty, labiaplasty, hymenoplasty, and pelvic floor rejuvenation with strict confidentiality.
- [Cervical Health & Cancer Screening](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/cervical-health-services/): Liquid-based cytology Pap smear screening, colposcopy, and HPV cervical cancer vaccination.
- [Vaginal Surgery Procedures](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/vaginal-surgery-services/): Non-descent vaginal hysterectomy (NDVH) and pelvic organ prolapse reconstruction.
- [Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP)](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/medical-termination-of-pregnancy-mtp-services/): Safe, legal, and confidential pregnancy termination services strictly compliant with the MTP Act of India.
- [Uterine Fibroid Treatment](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/uterine-fibroids/): Monitoring, medicines, laparoscopic and hysteroscopic myomectomy (keeps the uterus), and hysterectomy when family is complete.
- [PCOS / PCOD Treatment](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/pcos-pcod-treatment/): Diagnosis (Rotterdam criteria), lifestyle plan, cycle regulation, acne and hair treatment, and ovulation induction for pregnancy.
- [Endometriosis Treatment](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/endometriosis-treatment/): Pain relief, hormonal treatment, and laparoscopic excision and chocolate-cyst removal that preserves fertility.
- [Ovarian Cyst Treatment](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/ovarian-cysts/): Ultrasound risk assessment, monitoring, and laparoscopic cystectomy that preserves the ovary.
- [Laparoscopic Hysterectomy (TLH)](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/laparoscopic-hysterectomy/): Keyhole uterus removal for fibroids, adenomyosis and heavy bleeding; ovaries preserved when appropriate.
- [Menopause Care](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/menopause-care/): Symptom relief (lifestyle, non-hormonal treatment, MHT), bone and heart health, and evaluation of bleeding after menopause.
- [Normal & Painless Delivery](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/painless-normal-delivery/): Birth preparation, labour care, epidural pain relief options and VBAC counselling.
- [Clinic & Outpatient Treatments](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/clinic-and-treatments/): Routine gynecology consultations, ultrasound diagnostics, and adolescent/menopause clinics.

## Patient Guides & Articles
- [Breech Baby Presentation](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/breech-baby-understanding-breech-presentation-in-pregnancy/): Diagnosis, ECV procedure, and delivery safety.
- [How Does a Baby Breathe Inside the Womb](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/how-does-a-baby-breathe-inside-the-womb/): Placental oxygen exchange and fetal practice breathing.
- [Natural Ways to Boost Fertility](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/natural-ways-to-boost-fertility/): Nutrition, ovulation tracking, and preconceptional guidance.
- [Understanding Ectopic Pregnancy](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/understanding-ectopic-pregnancy-symptoms-risks-treatment/): Warning signs, diagnostic ultrasound, and keyhole management.
- [Pads, Tampons or Menstrual Cups](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/pads-tampons-or-menstrual-cups-which-period-product-is-right-for-you/): Hygiene, comfort, and safety comparison.
- [Postpartum Recovery Guide](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/postpartum-recovery-how-to-take-care-of-your-body-and-mind-after-delivery/): Physical healing, lochia bleeding, and mental health after birth.
- [Post-Dated Pregnancy Management](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/post-dated-pregnancy-causes-risks-management/): Risks, fetal monitoring, and induction guidelines after 40 weeks.
- [Understanding IUFD (Fetal Demise)](https://drmuditajaintalesra.com/understanding-iufd-intrauterine-fetal-demise-causes-symptoms-and-support/): Compassionate medical explanation and preventive kick counts.
